name: Native AWQ per-lane staging proof checkpoint
body:
Independent native AWQ FP16 adaptation: complete per-lane A-then-B staging.

The unchanged full source template is bound in four N64/N128 instances. Lean now proves the first native block visit plus complete A and B staging for each lane, ending at the middle barrier with the original lane512 fuel. Every staged value, read-only input, outside-memory frame, accumulator and ordering epoch is retained. The actual per-lane order and exact trace length are preserved.

Fresh source checks and a standalone replay without Git or owned compiled caches each pass 363 axiom audits (29 owned modules, 311 library and 52 source audits). Six changed sources fail on false source identity. Thirty-one fully rehashed scope controls fail before extraction. All 27 AWQ Lean resources match the built wheel. Historical 256- and 90-audit archives remain readable.

The attached source archive is byte-identical to the independently replayed archive. Logs, strict reader, scope controls and numerical evidence are in the repository. This checkpoint adds no GPU launches or model calls; the earlier paired AMD study retains 120 launches and 820,224 CPU float64 output comparisons with no tolerance failures or host bit differences.

The full 64-lane staging visit and middle barrier resumption, matrix execution, K-loop induction, output stores, actual whole-trace race freedom and dense-reference equality remain unfinished. AWQ source certificates: 0. The accepted independent production-family count remains eight. This is not a reproduction of the paper's exact adapted PTX, original model/token results, NVIDIA measurements or IEEE rounding behavior. Full repository CI is tracked separately from these completed local checks.
